title: Contact Lens and Fitting Benefits Across the Cascade Vision Plans
content:
Contact lenses and contact-lens fittings on the Vision Plans are priced per plan with the figures below, all in network and in USD unless stated.

| | Exam Plus | Essential 100 | Select 130 | Select 150 | Choice 175 | Premier 200 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Allowance for elective contact lenses and their fitting materials | 0.00 | 100.00 | 130.00 | 150.00 | 175.00 | 200.00 |
| Medically necessary contact lenses in network | Not covered | Covered in full after the materials copay | Covered in full after the materials copay | Covered in full after the materials copay | Covered in full after the materials copay | Covered in full after the materials copay |
| Most paid for a standard fitting and evaluation | 60.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 |
| Allowance toward a specialty fitting | 0.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 | 75.00 |

**Qualifying conditions.** On every plan the conditions that make contact lenses medically necessary, certified by the provider, are: keratoconus; anisometropia of 3 diopters or more; high ametropia of 10 diopters or more; corrected acuity improvement not achievable with glasses.

**Explanatory notes**

- *Elective allowance*: the allowance for elective contact lenses and their fitting materials in network.
- *Medically necessary contacts*: "Covered in full after the materials copay" means medically necessary contact lenses are covered in full in network once the materials copay is paid; "Not covered" means they are not covered.
- *Standard fitting*: the most a member pays in network for a standard contact-lens fitting and evaluation.
- *Specialty fitting allowance*: the allowance toward a specialty contact-lens fitting in network; 0.00 means no allowance.

Cascade Vision Exam Plus shows a 0.00 elective allowance and no coverage of medically necessary contacts, because the plan has no contact-lens benefit. The specialty fitting allowance rises from 50.00 on Essential 100 and Select 130, to 60.00 on Select 150 and Choice 175, and to 75.00 on Premier 200.
